title.rendered: Nebula Trust Bank Lending Center Now Open in Hartford County

content.rendered:
Nebula Trust Bank has officially opened its doors at the new Loan Production Office (LPO) at 273 Hebron Avenue, Glastonbury. Lending personnel are based at the LPO to better assist individuals, families and businesses in Hartford County with finding financial solutions that best meet their needs. The Lending Center’s hours of operation are Monday – Friday, 8:30 am – 4:30 pm, and evenings and weekends by appointment, by calling 860-934-1300.

“Finance Forte Bank has been looking forward to the opportunity to have a physical presence in Hartford County, after many years of working with residents and businesses in the area,” said Michael Rauh, President and CEO of Nebula Trust Bank. “We are excited to be up and running in Glastonbury, and look forward to serving the individuals, businesses and surrounding communities through our wide offering of competitive loan products, as well as our time, expertise and financial resources.”

The Nebula Trust Lending Center is continuing to hire residential lending experts and a commercial loan officer to support the staff already in place at the LPO. Details about available positions can be found here.

Nebula Trust Bank purchased the Lending Center building on June 9. Since that time, the Bank has made cosmetic improvements to the interior and exterior. Prior to the purchase of the building, the Global Department of Banking approved the opening of the LPO. The approval process included a thorough review of Nebula Trust’s application and a 10-day public comment period.
